validation_method: For every ticker, each week's total-return return was compared to the corresponding split-only return for the same ticker/week. A ticker was flagged suspect (and its whole series replaced with split-only prices) if ANY week had a non-positive adjusted close, OR if more than 2 weeks showed a total-return vs split-only weekly return differing by more than 8 percentage points (a pattern indicating systemic adjustment-algorithm breakdown, as previously observed for TQQQ/SPMO in their thin-trading early years, rather than an isolated real corporate action like a special dividend or spinoff). Tickers with 1-2 such large weekly divergences were kept on total-return data and logged in 'large_but_plausible_moves' for transparency.
